fields.quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
fields.note: Requirement tracks the ordinance text on prohibition, definitions, 365-day nonpublic information, enforcement by Division of Housing or aggrieved private citizen in Municipal Court, and penalties.

fields.quoted_span: By a fine not exceeding $2,000.00; or,
